notes:
Feed for the bus operator Viação Piracicabana, concessionaire of STPC/DF Bacia 1 (North: Brasília/Plano Piloto, Sobradinho, Planaltina, Cruzeiro, Lago Norte, Varjão, Fercal; ~417 buses, ~238 routes). NOTE ON SCOPE: The "metro/rail first" directive does not apply here — Piracicabana runs only diesel buses (route_type 3); the Brasília Metro (Orange/Green lines) is a separate operator, Companhia do Metropolitano do DF (METRÔ-DF), not Piracicabana, so no rail line belongs in this operator's feed. Several Piracicabana lines terminate AT metro-integrated terminals (Terminal Asa Sul, Central/Rodoviária), which is reflected in headsigns.

SOURCES: line 0.640 itinerary (85 ordered stops) from a published Cittamobi PDF (linhas.cittamobi.com.br, doc dated 2026-04-02); operating hours + average frequency per day-type from that PDF's TABELA HORÁRIA and from dfnoponto.com/horario/0.640 and Moovit line 850942 (Área 1 - Piracicabana). Lines 0.509 and 512.1 origin/destination and stop counts from Moovit. Terminal coordinates from OpenStreetMap / Wikipedia (WGS-84): Rodoviária do Plano Piloto / Central metro -15.79389,-47.88278; Terminal Asa Sul / Asa Sul metro -15.837083,-47.932694; Terminal Sobradinho -15.658018,-47.792535; Planaltina seat -15.61917,-47.65250.

DATA-QUALITY LIMITATIONS (drive the 0.45 confidence):
1. The published itineraries expose ~85-178 stops per line, but almost all are raw reverse-geocoded street addresses WITHOUT coordinates and heavily duplicated. Placing each precisely was not possible from the sources, so I did NOT fabricate ~80 uncoordinated points. Instead each route is modeled over its evidenced, reliably-geocodable ANCHOR stops (terminals + major corridor waypoints: Setor Tradicional, BR-020/Sobradinho, Lago Norte/EPTT, W3 Norte, Central/Rodoviária, W3 Sul). This is a faithful skeleton of the real alignment, not the full stop list.
2. Only line 0.640 has a fully evidenced ordered itinerary + per-day operating window + average headway. 0.509 and 512.1 have confirmed endpoints and day-of-week operation but their intermediate anchors are inferred from the shared Sobradinho↔Asa Sul corridor and their times are even-headway approximations across the operating window.
3. Departure times are realistic clock times derived from the published operating window and average frequency (e.g. 0.640 weekday 04:00–21:15 @ ~73 min); per-stop times interpolate the published ~90 min end-to-end running time across the anchor sequence.
4. Planaltina terminal coordinate is the administrative-region seat (exact terminal building coord not available); flagged as approximate.
5. The requested OSM bus_stop cross-reference (nodes tagged BR-5300108-<code>) could not be resolved to individual stop coordinates from the available web sources.

Only stops with real evidence and defensible WGS-84 coordinates are included; representative trips cover both directions of each route with a calendar matching the published Mon-Fri / Sat / Sun-holiday service.
